```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Handoff deck for the ENPH beverage-elasticity revision.
# It reads the SAME validated bundle as manuscript/manuscript.Rmd (run fixed in params$run_id),
# applies the manuscript's consistency checks, and never reruns data processing or estimation.
# Storyboard, timing and presenter notes: reports/slides-handsoff_outline.md.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE,
  dev = "cairo_pdf", fig.align = "center",
  fig.width = 6.0, fig.height = 2.7, out.width = "100%"
)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

# ---- The manuscript's bundle: one run, checked as the manuscript checks it ----------------------
run_id <- params$run_id
if (is.null(run_id) || !nzchar(run_id)) stop("params$run_id is empty: set it to the run the manuscript was rendered from", call. = FALSE)
root <- normalizePath("..", winslash = "/")
if (!file.exists(file.path(root, "ElasSsbColombia.Rproj"))) stop("Render slides-handsoff.Rmd from the reports/ folder of the repository", call. = FALSE)
bdir <- file.path(root, "data", "processed", "manuscript", run_id)
need <- function(path, producer) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Missing result file: ", path, "\n  Produced by: ", producer, call. = FALSE)
  path
}
by_report <- sprintf("powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File run_pipeline.ps1 -Stage report -RunId %s", run_id)
man <- jsonlite::read_json(need(file.path(bdir, "manifest.json"), by_report))
v   <- readRDS(need(file.path(bdir, "values.rds"), by_report))
res <- readRDS(need(file.path(bdir, "results.rds"), by_report))
sha <- function(f) digest::digest(file = f, algo = "sha256")
if (!identical(man$run_id, run_id) || !identical(v$run_id, run_id) || !identical(res$run_id, run_id))
  stop("Bundle components belong to different runs", call. = FALSE)
if (!identical(man$config_sha256, sha(file.path(root, "config", "config.yml"))) ||
    !identical(man$models_sha256, sha(file.path(root, "config", "models.csv"))))
  stop("Stale bundle: config/config.yml or config/models.csv changed after run '", run_id, "' was reported", call. = FALSE)
if (!isTRUE(man$complete) && !isTRUE(params$draft))
  stop("Bundle for run '", run_id, "' is incomplete (output/tables/", run_id, "/table_completeness.csv); render with draft = TRUE only for a labelled draft", call. = FALSE)
if (!isTRUE(v$inference_available) && !isTRUE(params$draft))
  stop("Bootstrap inference is not available for run '", run_id, "'; render with draft = TRUE only for a labelled draft", call. = FALSE)
qrules <- fread(need(file.path(root, "output", "diagnostics", run_id, "quantity_rules.csv"),
                     sprintf("Rscript code/R/00_run.R construct --run-id=%s", run_id)))
rinfo_f <- file.path(root, "output", "manuscript", run_id, "render_info.json")
rinfo <- if (file.exists(rinfo_f)) jsonlite::read_json(rinfo_f) else NULL

# ---- Formatting ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
fmt <- function(x, d = 2) ifelse(is.na(x), "n.a.", sub("^-", "\u2212", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d)))
n0  <- function(x) formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ",")
pct <- function(x, d = 0) paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = d), "\\%")
claim <- function(ok, title) if (!isTRUE(ok)) stop("Data no longer support the title: ", title, call. = FALSE)
lab <- res$labels
goods <- v$goods_estimable

# ---- Estimates (named values written by the report stage) ----------------------------------------
el   <- function(key) { x <- v$el[[key]]; if (is.null(x)) stop("Value missing from the bundle: ", key, call. = FALSE); x }
own  <- function(spec, mk, g) el(paste("own", spec, mk, g, sep = "_"))
expd <- function(spec, mk, g) el(paste("exp", spec, mk, g, sep = "_"))
crs  <- function(mk, r, cc) el(paste("cross", mk, r, cc, sep = "_"))
ci   <- function(x) if (is.na(x$lo)) "n.a." else paste0(fmt(x$lo), " to ", fmt(x$hi))
ci_lv <- unique(res$est$ci_level[!is.na(res$est$ci_level)])
if (length(ci_lv) != 1) stop("The results hold more than one interval level", call. = FALSE)
ci_pct <- paste0(round(100 * ci_lv), "\\%")
sb_c <- own("M1", "combined", "sb"); sb_h <- own("M1", "home", "sb")

# ---- Bootstrap status ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
st  <- res$status
fin <- st[bootclass == "final"]; sen <- st[bootclass == "sens"]
B <- list(reps = max(fin$completed), reps_min = min(fin$completed), target = v$boot_target,
          nfin = nrow(fin), nsens = nrow(sen), sens_reps = max(sen$completed), sens_target = max(sen$target),
          failed = sum(st$failed), final = isTRUE(v$inference_final))
B$range <- if (B$reps_min == B$reps) n0(B$reps) else paste0(n0(B$reps_min), "--", n0(B$reps))
B$note  <- if (B$final) sprintf("%s cluster-bootstrap replications", n0(B$reps)) else
  sprintf("preliminary inference: %s of %s cluster-bootstrap replications", n0(B$reps), n0(B$target))
draft_tag <- if (isTRUE(params$draft)) " \\textbf{DRAFT: incomplete bundle.}" else ""

# ---- Historical values, typed once from their sources (never current estimates) -----------------
# src: docs/Paper_20_1012_ElasticiBeverages.pdf, Table 3 (p. 20): SB, Model 1, full market -0.503 [0.003]; off trade -0.355 [0.004]
# src: output/replication/legacy_run/duvm_total.log:584 and duvm_hogar.log:583 (WELCOM 2.30, Table 06, Model 1): -0.438, -0.469
#      (same values in docs/reproducibility_audit.md, section 1.6)
legacy <- list(pub_full = -0.503, pub_off = -0.355, pub_se_full = 0.003, rerun_full = -0.438, rerun_off = -0.469)
# src: docs/reproducibility_audit.md, revision 2 (2026-11-17)
aud <- list(beer_pred = 78667,              # section 2.9: non-buyers with a regression-imputed beer price
            trim = "8--11",                 # section 2.6: buyers recoded to non-buyers (7.9% to 10.8%)
            se = "0.003--0.006",            # section 1.6: SB own-price SEs, published [0.003]/[0.004], rerun 0.004/0.006
            t2_full = 25, t2_off = 24,      # section 0: Table 2 cells reproduced within 0.01
            clus_rep = 354, clus_rebuilt = 384, welcom_rep = "2.1", welcom_audit = "2.30")
# src: docs/blockers.md B-4: about 75 main replications an hour on 12 workers, about 7 more hours
boot_hours <- 7

# ---- Values used in titles and text --------------------------------------------------------------
N <- list(enph = n0(v$n_enph), legacy = n0(v$n_legacy), elig = n0(v$n_sample_combined), urban = n0(v$n_urban),
          rural = n0(v$n_sample_combined - v$n_urban), nobev = n0(v$n_no_beverage),
          wt_m = formatC(v$weight_total / 1e6, format = "f", digits = 1),
          textid = n0(v$text_identified_records), composite = n0(v$composite_records),
          clus = n0(v$n_clusters_m1), uvbeer = n0(v$n_uv_beer), clusbeer = n0(v$clusters_uv_beer),
          models = n0(nrow(res$models)), sp_spend = n0(v$spend_comb_spirits))
qty_rules <- c("direct_unit", "other_unit_dane_equivalence", "weight_to_litre_density_1.03")
sp_rec <- qrules[category == "spirits", sum(N)]
sp_qty <- qrules[category == "spirits" & qty_rule %in% qty_rules, sum(N)]
N$sp_rec <- n0(sp_rec); N$sp_qty <- n0(sp_qty)
P <- list(text_sb = pct(v$text_share_comb_sb, 1), sp_prev = pct(v$prev_comb_spirits),
          beer_pred = pct(aud$beer_pred / v$n_legacy), qcov_sb = pct(v$qcov_home_sb), qcov_beer = pct(v$qcov_home_beer))
S <- list(m1c = fmt(sb_c$est), m1h = fmt(sb_h$est), ci_c = ci(sb_c), ci_h = ci(sb_h),
          e1 = fmt(expd("M1", "combined", "sb")$est), e2 = fmt(expd("M2", "combined", "sb")$est),
          leg = fmt(legacy$pub_full))

# ---- Guards: every title that states a result ----------------------------------------------------
claim(sb_c$hi < legacy$pub_full, "Rebuilt from raw ENPH, SB demand is more price-responsive than first reported")
claim(v$n_sample_combined <= v$n_enph && v$n_no_beverage > 0, "The rebuilt sample keeps all ENPH households, non-buyers included")
claim(v$qcov_home_spirits == 0 && sp_qty == 0 && sp_rec > 0, "Spending is not a price: no spirits or wine purchase records a quantity")
claim(v$composite_records > v$text_identified_records, "A text record counts as a drink purchase only if it names nothing else")
spec_d <- function(mk) vapply(paste0("M", 2:6), function(s) abs(own(s, mk, "sb")$est - own("M1", mk, "sb")$est), 1)
claim(names(which.max(spec_d("combined"))) == "M4" && names(which.max(spec_d("home"))) == "M4",
      "SB's own-price elasticity is ... in M1, and regional controls matter most")
claim(sb_c$hi < 0 && sb_h$hi < 0, "SB purchases respond to price (intervals below zero)")
claim(expd("M1", "combined", "sb")$est < expd("M2", "combined", "sb")$est, "Expenditure elasticities hinge on the selection term")
claim(!isTRUE(B$final), "Inference is preliminary")

# ---- Plot styling (beverage colours match beamer_preamble.tex) -----------------------------------
deck_font <- "Calibri"
col_key <- "#0F2A56"; col_m4 <- "#B35806"; col_alert <- "#B2182B"; col_muted <- "grey60"
theme_deck <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11, base_family = deck_font) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0))

# LaTeX table from a data frame (booktabs, no float)
ltab <- function(df, align, header = names(df)) {
  cat("\\begin{tabular}{", align, "}\n\\toprule\n", paste(header, collapse = " & "), " \\\\\n\\midrule\n", sep = "")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) cat(paste(unlist(df[i, ]), collapse = " & "), " \\\\\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\bottomrule\n\\end{tabular}\n")
}
```

## Rebuilt from raw ENPH, SB demand is more price-responsive than first reported

:::
::::

Household purchases, not intake. Sweetened beverages (SB), not sugar-sweetened (SSB). Price differences across local markets, not a causal tax effect.
\end{uncertaintyblock}

# A. The survey

## The rebuilt sample keeps all `r N$enph` ENPH households, non-buyers included

:::: columns
::: {.column width="31%"}
\midnumber{`r N$legacy`}{\textbf{Legacy file}\\ households with a beverage record and under 16 litres per adjusted member a day}
:::
::: {.column width="31%"}
\midnumber{`r N$enph`}{\textbf{ENPH universe}\\ every household in the public file, representing `r N$wt_m` million}
:::
::: {.column width="31%"}
\midnumber{`r N$elig`}{\textbf{Estimation-eligible}\\ `r N$urban` urban, `r N$rural` rural; `r N$nobev` with no beverage purchase stay as zeros}
:::
::::

\sourceline{ENPH 2016--2017, collected July 2016 to June 2017 \parencite{DANE2018ENPH}. Sample flow of run `r run_id` (manuscript Table A1).}

## Only two instruments record quantities, so only they yield unit values

\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}YcccL{2.75cm}@{}}
\toprule
Instrument & Spending & Quantity & Unit value & Role \\
\midrule
Urban household diary (14 days) & \yes & \yes & \yes & Price and share \\ \addlinespace[3pt]
Rural household questionnaire (week) & \yes & \yes & \yes & Price and share \\ \addlinespace[3pt]
Personal diaries (7 days) & \yes & \no & \no & Share only \\ \addlinespace[3pt]
Away-from-home records (free text) & \yes & \no & \no & Share only \\ \addlinespace[3pt]
Usual purchases by food group & \yes & \no & \no & Share only \\ \addlinespace[3pt]
Monthly recall (spirits and wine) & \yes & \no & \no & Share only \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabularx}

\sourceline{\yes{} recorded \quad \no{} not recorded: personal and away-from-home records give item counts, not volumes, and away-from-home spending enters only the combined market. Amounts are converted to a month with DANE's factors \parencite{DANE2020ENPHMetodologia}; they measure purchases, not intake.}

## A text record counts as a drink purchase only if it names nothing else

:::: columns
::: {.column width="47%"}
**Six groups, from COICOP codes and text** \parencite{UN2018COICOP}

- **SB**: soft drinks, malt drinks, packaged juices and teas, energy drinks. Sugar and other sweeteners cannot be told apart.
- Beer; spirits and wine; water.
- Dairy drinks (litres) and hot drinks (kilograms at home), now kept apart.
:::
::: {.column width="49%"}
\midnumber{`r N$textid`}{text records name one beverage and nothing else: counted}
\midnumber{`r N$composite`}{name a drink with other items, such as a meal: not attributed}
:::
::::

\sourceline{Text rule after \textcite{MaldonadoGarciaJimenez2022Consumption}, now requiring a pure beverage description. Text purchases add `r P$text_sb` of combined-market SB spending.}

## Spending is not a price: no spirits or wine purchase records a quantity

```{r fig-coverage, fig.height = 1.8}
cov <- data.table(g = res$categories)
cov[, `:=`(lab = factor(lab[g], levels = rev(lab[res$categories])),
           q = vapply(g, function(x) v[[paste0("qcov_home_", x)]], 1))]
cov[, txt := ifelse(q == 0, "0%: no quantity, so no unit value", paste0(round(100 * q), "%"))]
ggplot(cov, aes(x = q, y = lab)) +
  geom_col(fill = col_key, width = 0.62) +
  geom_text(aes(label = txt, colour = q == 0), hjust = -0.08, size = 3.7, family = deck_font) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = col_alert, `FALSE` = "grey20"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.25), breaks = NULL) +
  theme_deck + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, colour = "grey15"))
```

Off-trade: purchases for the home. Combined: adds away-from-home spending at the same unit values, so no on-trade price response is identified.

\sourceline{Share of off-trade spending in purchases with a recorded quantity; run `r run_id`. None of the `r N$sp_rec` spirits and wine purchase records has one.}

## Clearer labels resolve several puzzles in the published tables

<!-- src: docs/Paper_20_1012_ElasticiBeverages.pdf abstract, Tables 2, 5, 6; audit sections 1.6, 2.4, 2.11, 2.13 -->

\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}YY@{}}
\toprule
In the published tables & In the revision \\
\midrule
Off-trade consumption column permuted: beer, spirits and water values swapped & Every table is written from code output \\ \addlinespace[4pt]
“Dairy” is milk plus hot drinks in one panel, milk only in another & Dairy drinks and hot drinks are two goods throughout \\ \addlinespace[4pt]
“Income elasticities” computed with total expenditure & Named expenditure elasticities \\ \addlinespace[4pt]
Abstract reads substitution toward alcohol; Table 5 shows negative responses to the SB price & Rows respond, columns change price; the claim is withdrawn \\

\sourceline{The very small standard errors were real software output, not typing errors. More items in backup.}

# C. The rebuilt estimates

## Unit values mix price, quality and noise; markets help separate them

```{=latex}
\begin{center}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  cpart/.style={draw=decknavy!50, fill=decknavy!5, rounded corners=2pt, align=center, text width=3.5cm, minimum height=1.05cm, font=\small},
  cuv/.style={draw=decknavy, fill=decknavy!14, rounded corners=2pt, align=center, text width=2.9cm, minimum height=1.3cm},
  cout/.style={draw=statusgood!60, fill=statusgood!6, rounded corners=2pt, align=left, text width=4.9cm, minimum height=1.3cm, font=\small},
  carr/.style={-{Stealth[length=2mm]}, draw=black!55, line width=0.6pt}]
\node[cpart] (price) at (0, 1.35) {Market price,\\ shared within a local market};
\node[cpart] (qual)  at (0, 0)    {Quality chosen,\\ rises with total spending};
\node[cpart] (err)   at (0, -1.35){Measurement error};
\node[cuv]   (uvn)   at (4.2, 0)  {\textbf{Unit value}\\ spending ÷ quantity};
\node[cout]  (win)   at (9.4, 0.85) {\textbf{Within a market} the price is fixed, so household differences show quality and expenditure effects.};
\node[cout]  (btw)   at (9.4, -0.85){\textbf{Between markets}, average shares against average unit values, net of quality and noise, show the price response.};
\draw[carr] (price.east) -- (uvn.west);
\draw[carr] (qual.east)  -- (uvn.west);
\draw[carr] (err.east)   -- (uvn.west);
\draw[carr] (uvn.east)   -- (win.west);
\draw[carr] (uvn.east)   -- (btw.west);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{center}
```

Key assumption: households in one municipality, area and quarter face the same price.

\sourceline{Deaton's unit-value model \parencite{Deaton1988QualityQuantityPrice, Deaton1997HouseholdSurveys}, estimated with WELCOM's duvm \parencite{AraarEtAl2018WELCOM}. Equations in backup.}

## Each correction answers an audit finding and leaves a stated limit

\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}YYY@{}}
\toprule
Legacy problem & Rebuilt pipeline & Still limited by \\
\midrule
Predicted “prices” for non-buyers & Unit values only where a quantity was recorded & Sparse beer, noisy water \\ \addlinespace[3pt]
Buyers trimmed, non-buyers dropped & All households; zeros kept & No exclusion restriction for selection \\ \addlinespace[3pt]
Basket shares, total-budget regressor & Both on DANE total expenditure & Unconditional, Marshallian only \\ \addlinespace[3pt]
Clusters cut from a dwelling code & `r N$clus` markets: municipality × area × quarter & Prices vary across regions \\ \addlinespace[3pt]
First stage fixed in the bootstrap & External bootstrap reruns all of WELCOM & `r n0(B$reps)` of `r n0(B$target)` replications; design not modelled \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabularx}

\sourceline{WELCOM `r v$welcom_version` applies Deaton's quality and measurement-error corrections and imposes symmetry; weights enter as cluster averages, an approximation \parencite{AraarEtAl2018WELCOM, CameronGelbachMiller2008}.}

## SB's own-price elasticity is `r S$m1c` in M1, and regional controls matter most

```{r fig-sb-own, fig.height = 2.45}
spec_lab <- c(M1 = "M1 Primary", M2 = "M2 No selection term", M3 = "M3 No weights",
              M4 = "M4 No regional controls", M5 = "M5 Coded purchases only", M6 = "M6 Urban only (other population)")
d <- res$est[spec %chin% names(spec_lab) & stat == "price" & row == "sb" & col == "sb",
             .(spec, market, est = estimate, lo = ci_lo, hi = ci_hi)]
d[, mk := factor(ifelse(market == "combined", "Combined market", "Off-trade market"), levels = c("Combined market", "Off-trade market"))]
d[, y := factor(spec_lab[spec], levels = rev(spec_lab))]
xlo <- -2; xhi <- 0.5
d[, `:=`(lo_c = pmax(lo, xlo), hi_c = pmin(hi, xhi), cut_lo = lo < xlo)]
d[, grp := fifelse(spec == "M1", "M1", fifelse(spec == "M4", "M4", "other"))]
ggplot(d, aes(y = y)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = lo_c, xend = hi_c, yend = y, colour = grp), linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_segment(data = d[cut_lo == TRUE], aes(x = lo_c + 0.2, xend = lo_c, yend = y, colour = grp),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(1.6, "mm"), type = "closed"), linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(x = est, colour = grp), size = 2.3) +
  geom_text(data = d[spec %in% c("M1", "M4")], aes(x = est, label = fmt(est), colour = grp),
            vjust = -0.75, size = 3.4, family = deck_font, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(M1 = col_key, M4 = col_m4, other = col_muted), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(xlo, xhi), breaks = c(-2, -1.5, -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5), labels = fmt(c(-2, -1.5, -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5), 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~mk) + theme_deck + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey15"), panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"))
m3 <- d[spec == "M3"]
```

Open: M1, with WELCOM's selection term. Filled: M2, without. M1 stays primary; the manuscript reads M2 as the more interpretable expenditure response`r if (expd("M1", "combined", "beer")$est < 0) " and beer's negative M1 value as an artefact" else ""`.

\sourceline{Combined market, same households. Elasticities of quantity with respect to total household expenditure, not income; the probit has no exclusion restriction \parencite{Heckman1979Selection}.}

## Tercile and cross-price patterns are suggestive, not yet robust

```{r tercile-cross}
tc <- lapply(c("T1", "T2", "T3"), function(s) own(s, "combined", "sb"))
te <- vapply(tc, function(x) x$est, 1)
t_mono <- if (all(diff(te) > 0)) "Estimates shrink with income" else if (all(diff(te) < 0)) "Estimates grow with income" else "Estimates do not move monotonically with income"
t_ovl  <- if (tc[[1]]$hi < tc[[3]]$lo || tc[[3]]$hi < tc[[1]]$lo) "the lowest and highest intervals do not overlap" else "the lowest and highest intervals overlap"
cells <- CJ(r = goods, cc = goods)[r != cc]
cells[, `:=`(est = mapply(function(a, b) crs("combined", a, b)$est, r, cc),
             lo = mapply(function(a, b) crs("combined", a, b)$lo, r, cc),
             hi = mapply(function(a, b) crs("combined", a, b)$hi, r, cc))]
ns <- res$est[model_id == "M1_combined" & stat == "price_nosym" & row != col, .(r = row, cc = col, nosym = estimate)]
cells <- merge(cells, ns, by = c("r", "cc"))
X <- list(ncell = nrow(cells), nsig = cells[lo > 0 | hi < 0, .N], flip = cells[sign(est) != sign(nosym), .N])
claim(X$ncell == length(goods) * (length(goods) - 1) && !anyNA(cells$nosym), "cross-price cells complete")
```

## Deaton's model pairs a unit-value and a budget-share equation

\begin{align*}
\ln v_{ghc} &= \alpha^1_g + \beta^1_g \ln x_{hc} + \gamma^{1\prime}_g z_{hc} + \textstyle\sum_{j}\psi_{gj}\ln p_{jc} + u^1_{ghc}\\
w_{ghc} &= \alpha^0_g + \beta^0_g \ln x_{hc} + \gamma^{0\prime}_g z_{hc} + \textstyle\sum_{j}\theta_{gj}\ln p_{jc} + f_{gc} + u^0_{ghc}
\end{align*}

Good $g$, household $h$, price cluster $c$; $v$ unit value, $w$ share of total expenditure $x$, $z$ household controls, $p$ prices common within a cluster. Within-cluster regressions give $\beta^1$ (quality) and $\beta^0$; cluster means of the residual parts, corrected for measurement error and quality, give the price responses. Expenditure elasticity: $1-\beta^1_g+\beta^0_g/\bar w_g$.

\sourceline{\textcite{Deaton1990PriceElasticities}; \textcite{Deaton1997HouseholdSurveys}, chapter 5; manuscript section 2.1 and docs/welcom\_method.md.}

```{r bk-matrix, results = "asis"}
}
```

```{r bk-prov, results = "asis"}
            sprintf("git %s%s", substr(man$git_commit, 1, 7), if (isTRUE(man$git_dirty)) " (uncommitted changes)" else ""),
            sprintf("config %s; models %s", substr(man$config_sha256, 1, 10), substr(man$models_sha256, 1, 10)),
            sprintf("WELCOM duvm %s (%s), sha256 %s", man$estimator$version, man$estimator$date, substr(man$estimator$duvm_sha256, 1, 10)),
            sprintf("Stata %s; %s", man$estimator$stata, sub(" \\(.*", "", man$r$version)),
            paste(unlist(man$seeds), collapse = ", "),
            sprintf("%s required: %s available, %s not estimable, %s not measured, %s missing", cp$required_cells, cp$available, cp$not_estimable, cp$not_measured, cp$missing),
            if (is.null(rinfo)) "not found" else sprintf("rendered %s, %s pages", substr(rinfo$rendered, 1, 16), rinfo$pages)))
cat("\\begin{center}\\small\n\\begin{tabularx}{\\textwidth}{@{}L{3.2cm}Y@{}}\n\\toprule\nItem & Value \\\\\n\\midrule\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(prov))) cat(prov$Item[i], " & ", gsub("_", "\\\\_", prov$Value[i]), " \\\\\n", sep = "")
cat("\\bottomrule\n\\end{tabularx}\n\\end{center}\n")
```

\sourceline{Checks at render: one run id across manifest, values and results; configuration hashes match; bundle complete; inference available.}
